policy.notes: No generated or placeholder media was created. Proposed paths are reservations only and are not referenced by production metadata or image loaders.

assets.name: brand-mark-exploration
assets.purpose: Explore name-independent operational-cartography directions before deterministic SVG refinement.
assets.productionBrief: Compact linked frame/node symbol; legible in monochrome and at favicon size; not crypto, analytics, a gauge, sparkle, or OpenAI-like knot.
assets.accessibility: Brand identity; adjacent product name remains text where needed.
assets.regenerationInstructions: Requires the actual Higgsfield MCP and variant review.
assets.usageRestrictions: Redraw selected concept deterministically; do not ship a raw raster as the only mark.

assets.name: login-hero-stills
assets.purpose: Establish connected professional-work atmosphere without competing with authentication.
assets.productionBrief: Text-free editorial map of opportunity, client, project, repository, task, cost, invoice, and knowledge with strong sign-in-safe negative space.
assets.accessibility: Decorative; empty alt text and no information encoded only in the image.
assets.regenerationInstructions: Requires the actual Higgsfield MCP and in-context crop review.
assets.usageRestrictions: No people, fake UI, readable labels, neon, or third-party marks.

assets.name: login-ambient-loop
assets.purpose: Optional restrained connection motion on the login composition.
assets.productionBrief: Slow path tracing, small parallax, or gentle drift; no flashing, zooming, pulsing, or delayed sign-in.
assets.motionFallback: Poster/static still and prefers-reduced-motion disablement required.
assets.accessibility: Decorative motion; must be ignorable and pausable when controls are exposed.
assets.regenerationInstructions: Generate only if a still proves insufficient.
assets.usageRestrictions: No loop in authenticated operational screens.

assets.name: professional-empty-state-family
assets.purpose: Provide a restrained visual cue for the four highest-value initial empty states.
assets.placement: Inbox, Opportunities, Projects, Clients EmptyState consumers
assets.productionBrief: Four related text-free map fragments sharing line weight, material, perspective, and palette; each remains secondary to title and action.
assets.accessibility: Decorative; localized HTML communicates the state and action.
assets.regenerationInstructions: Requires the actual Higgsfield MCP and family-level comparison.
assets.usageRestrictions: Do not expand into filler illustrations across all screens.

assets.name: repository-presentation-image
assets.purpose: Present OwnDashboard in README, documentation, and optional Open Graph metadata using authentic fixture UI.
assets.placement: README/docs and metadata only after final file exists
assets.productionBrief: Deterministically composite a real /dev-preview screenshot with the approved mark and a quiet operational-cartography environment.
assets.accessibility: README image requires descriptive alt text; OG is metadata presentation.
assets.regenerationInstructions: Capture UI first, then use Higgsfield only for environmental framing and composite deterministically.
assets.usageRestrictions: No generated interface pixels, fake metrics, testimonials, users, or logos.

assets.name: context-explanation-assets
assets.purpose: Potentially explain disconnected integrations or AI limited context when copy and status components are insufficient.
assets.placement: One reusable system state or documentation diagram
assets.productionBrief: Minimal connection interruption or bounded-source diagram in the same editorial line language.
assets.accessibility: Prefer deterministic semantic diagrams; generated art remains decorative.
assets.regenerationInstructions: Reassess need after copy/component QA; do not generate by default.
assets.usageRestrictions: No bot, brain, glow, fake provider UI, or implied capability.
